timestamp_audit_and_boundaries.boundary_audit_explanation: External train and val parquets were partitioned on call_date (train <= 2021-08-26, val >= 2021-08-27). Exactly 113 cases in train.parquet had discharge extending into August 27 after val earliest discharge (2021-08-27 11:55:57.742000). Internal CV folds are partitioned strictly on discharge_start_ts to ensure zero backward leakage.

dataset_partitions.test_quarantine_notice: test.parquet is strictly quarantined from model selection and tuning. Evaluation on test is withheld due to verified ~85.4% right-censoring survivorship bias.

known_limitations: Single prominent congestion episode in July accounts for bulk of critical delays.
Right-censoring survivorship bias in test partition suppresses slow turnarounds.
PortWatch external weather and disruption indices are constant 0 in the catalog.
Arrival-time prediction scenario excludes all in-yard customs and inspection milestones.
YARD_BLOCK and YARD_SLOT static fields in Mendeley dataset are unconfirmed as initial vs final coordinates.
Default decision rule misses ~88.8% of critical delays; operational alert thresholds require team alignment.
